bio.text: Julia Brownley represents California's 26th Congressional District in the U.S. House, where she has served since January 2013; she is not running for re-election in 2026.
Before Congress she served on the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District board (1994-2006) and in the California State Assembly, District 41 (2006-2012).
She holds a bachelor's degree from George Washington University (1975) and a graduate degree from American University (1979).
